description:
Transform the static Service Level Agreement (SLA) document at /home/ga/Documents/SLA_Draft_Sentinels.odt into a dynamic template. 

1. Define four User Fields (Variables) with the following specific values:
   - Name: 'ClientName', Value: 'Omicron Industries'
   - Name: 'ContractDate', Value: 'October 1, 2025'
   - Name: 'UptimeTarget', Value: '99.99%'
   - Name: 'ServiceCredit', Value: '25%'

2. Replace ALL text placeholders in the document with these fields:
   - Replace '[CLIENT]', '[CLIENT NAME]', or '[Client]' with the 'ClientName' field.
   - Replace '[DATE]' or '[START DATE]' with the 'ContractDate' field.
   - Replace '[UPTIME]' with the 'UptimeTarget' field.
   - Replace '[CREDIT]' with the 'ServiceCredit' field.

3. Save the automated document as /home/ga/Documents/SLA_Omicron_Final.odt.
